source_tamil_lines: வேலையில்லாத தொல்லை காலை பனி போலே நீங்கி போனதே...
நான் எண்ணாத நல் வாழ்வுதான் தன்னால் வந்து சேர்ந்ததே.
முன்பின் அறியாதார் உறவால் என் மனம் போலவே
எந்தன் துயர் நீங்கவே நன்மை தந்திட வந்தார் இன்றே
english_lines: The trouble of unemployment has vanished like morning mist...
A good life I never imagined has come to me of its own accord.
This is a fine day of joy, a golden day of fortune...
Through the bond of one I had never known before, just as my heart wished,
I have found well-being—in the very form of love,
Today he came bringing goodness so that my sorrow might leave,
He was deceived, thinking me a lady of wealth,
notes: `சீமாட்டி` is rendered as a lady of wealth/status, preserving the plot's class-mistaken-identity irony rather than modernizing it to a job title.

translator_notes: The scene-16 performance link is retained as verified; the screenplay translation continues to contain only the source-visible singing cue, not a duplicate lyric body.
Authorship remains at later-anthology attribution tier.
